title: AI reread of head CT scans reported negative finds 16 unreported intracranial hemorrhages
summary: An FDA-approved convolutional neural network was applied retrospectively to 5,585 head CT scans reported as negative, from 6,565 consecutive scans at eight imaging sites. It flagged 28 scans, and three neuroradiologists confirmed hemorrhage in 16 that had not been reported, a radiologist false-negative rate of 1.6%. Review was retrospective, the reference was consensus reading, and AI performance on true negatives was not assessed.
ai_technology: FDA-approved convolutional neural network detecting intracranial hemorrhage on non-contrast head CT

evidence.tested: The AI flagged 28 of 5,585 negative-by-report scans, and consensus review of three neuroradiologists judged 16 to show missed hemorrhage.
evidence.unknown: Whether prospective AI peer review changes outcomes is not tested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network screened reported-negative scans to surface hemorrhages the original readers missed.
